mentions.name: Orbi
mentions.description: Orbi is an open-source (AGPL-3.0) AI agent that takes a software request all the way to a release. You describe what you want in a sentence; an AI agent writes the code and opens a PR, a separate review session checks it against the acceptance criteria, then Orbi merges and tags a release. It also handles ops issues like deploys and debugging. In October, 190 of the 197 PRs merged into Orbi's own repo were opened by Orbi.
